decisions_consumed: RFC-2026-025 §1-§5 (in effect since 2026-09-28): §5 item 1's record-only scope, item 5's demand for a mechanical check, item 6's rule that a governance PR is merged by the Owner personally. This batch appends §6, Proposed, and changes no word of §1-§5.

The Owner's words of 2026-10-07, `ข้อ 4 mw`, read by A0 as 'item 4: do it' (evidence/WP-0A-DB-00/product-owner-disposition-2026-10-07-rfc-025-s6.md): they direct writing the proposal, not its adoption.
assumptions: A0's reading of `ข้อ 4 mw` as 'item 4: do it' is right. If it is not, the PR is withdrawn.
An approved RFC is amended in its own text, as §5 was; the repository has no rule requiring a new RFC number for an amendment.
WP-0A-DB-00 owns RFC-2026-025 and scripts/db/**, so the classifier lives in scripts/db/ (RFC §6.6 item 4 offers a protocol path if the Owner prefers).
The CI checkout keeps full history (fetch-depth: 0); the new test builds its own throwaway git repository and does not depend on this tree's history.

security_privacy_cost_impact: No secret, credential, tenant data, provider or database is touched. The classifier reads git objects only, with argument arrays (no shell), literal pathspecs and no network. The test builds a throwaway repository under the OS temp directory with a synthetic author that is not an e-mail address, and removes it. Cost: §6, if adopted, replaces four role runs with one reading on records-only PRs and removes carry readings on mechanical syncs. No token or time figure is claimed.
migration_and_data_impact: None. No migration, policy, grant, probe or catalog change.
compatibility_impact: Tests 716 -> 717 (one in foundation-contract): floor 86 -> 87, name digest and assertion floor (1121 -> 1320, the guard's own count) moved in scripts/test-suite-contract.mjs; evidence/VERIFICATION.md written by the record script's render() and re-recorded after this refresh. No behaviour of any existing guard changes: §6 is text until the Owner decides, and the classifier is run by hand, not by CI.
known_limitations: The classifier decides the SHAPE of a diff, not whether a transcription is true; that is the reading §6.2 keeps.
A mechanical sync can still interact semantically with main (a validator the PR's records are judged by); §6.3 leaves that to CI on the final head.
The classifier script is not itself digested in test-kits/integrity-manifest.json; its test is (RFC §6.6 item 2).
CI does not run the classifier (RFC §6.6 item 1).
open_risks_or_blockers: open_blockers[203]: the Owner's decision on §6 and Q-025-6-1..3 (the Owner merges this governance PR personally); the role runs C0, A1, Q0 and R0 on this head, none run; the owed CI step, CONTRIBUTING_AGENTS.md citation and digest.
rollback_or_forward_fix: Before merge: close the PR. After merge: revert the commit in a reviewed PR; §6 is additive (one header line and an appended section), the script and its test are new, and the floor and digest lines return with the revert.
recommended_next_work_packages: The four role runs on this head (C0, A1, Q0, R0), then the Owner's decision on RFC-2026-025 §6 and its merge by the Owner. If adopted: WP-0A-A0-004's non-gating CI step for the classifier, WP-0A-A0-001's CONTRIBUTING_AGENTS.md citation.
